s: Columnar MPP analytical store where BI queries crunch historical truth - fed by pipelines, never by users directly.
w: ETL/ELT lands data (often via staging buckets), transformations model it (dbt style: raw -> staged -> marts). Massively parallel clusters scan compressed columns; results cached. Separation of compute/storage (Snowflake/BQ) lets warehouses sleep when unused. Concurrency scaling handles dashboard floods.
use: Company-wide BI: revenue dashboards, cohort analyses
Data science sandboxes querying petabyte history
avoid: Realtime sub-second alerting on raw events (stream processors first)

pat.d: Bronze raw -> Silver cleaned -> Gold modeled layers feeding BI/ML.

pits: Runaway query costs - enforce workload mgmt/quotas per team
Freshness lies - document pipeline lag on every dashboard
tips: ELT vs ETL distinction + dbt's role shows modern fluency
